commands.command: node scripts/generate-phase1-song.mjs verify && node scripts/validate-fixtures.mjs --cases shared/fixtures/phase1-schema-cases.json && node scripts/check-phase1-baseline.mjs && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs

verified_contracts: main scene reaches ready, one-second count-in, playing, and completed through audio-backed transport
startup selects exactly one of physical MIDI or deterministic replay
profile, chart, rules, settings, replay data, and audio load before scheduling playback
Tone, Ding, Slap, feedback, judgement, score, and combo share one session
pause gates input and resume preserves transport, scheduler index, and score records
completion HUD exposes score, accuracy, max combo, and judgement breakdown
load, chart, audio, MIDI, and transport failures enter failed state with diagnostics
P103 deterministic replay final summary equals the package golden summary
notes: The 4x replay speed is an acceptance-only CLI option; normal MIDI and replay gameplay default to 1x.
